read_for: the body changed (group A1): mortal and imperishable, the tent taken down and the dwelling from God, clothed upon (G4636, G1902, G1746, G0110, G0166, G1919): what these images say of the inner being's relation to its body
why: the OT-05 cuts grouped these verses; the R0 of Ch 2 (#2160) read only part of them (not 2Co 5:1-2, 1Co 15:42, 1Co 15:54); the tent and clothing handles (OT-05.34-36, .43, .51, .52) point here
comes_back_when: when Ch 2 The body raised is next widened, or the flesh-and-body reading (#2162) is taken up

read_for: put on (group A3): putting on Christ, the new self, clothing: the inner act named by the clothing verb
why: G1746 put on has two faces in the set: the body clothed with the imperishable (A1) and the person putting on Christ or the new self (A3); the second was not read
comes_back_when: when M45 Renewal and transformation or M76 Walk and conduct is read as a strand

read_for: the body words for the flesh-and-body reading (groups B3-B5: the body raised or redeemed, the body with the inner being, bodies otherwise; with Luk 24:39 'flesh and bones' beside 1Co 15:50 'flesh and blood', quoted but not reconciled): the body as the physical self, and the body set against or beside the inner being
why: the researcher read the 27 M47 body verses (2026-10-18) and directed Ch 7 to be expanded to flesh and body with all body and flesh verses re-collated (#2162, done); the reading itself (#2172) is on hold, so these verses wait for it
comes_back_when: when the flesh-and-body reading (#2172) is taken up
